review_candidates.description: About Cethos Cethos is a Calgary, Canada-based life-sciences language company specializing in linguistic validation, Clinical Outcome Assessments (COA/eCOA), cognitive debriefing, and clinician review, alongside certified translation in 200+ languages. We help CROs, pharma, biotech, medical device companies, and eCOA platform vendors run submission-ready, ISPOR-aligned translation and validation programs across global clinical trials. The Role You'll be our first dedicated operations leader, fully remote, owning delivery end to end: every project that comes in — linguistic validation, cognitive debriefing, clinician review, certified translation — leaves on time, on quality, and on margin. Today that machinery is run day-to-day by the founders; your job is to take it over, systematize it, and build the team that scales it. It's a hands-on leadership role for someone who has run production at a language service provider, BPO, or clinical-services company and wants real ownership of how an operation grows. This role works North American (Mountain Time) business hours, Monday to Friday — roughly 9am–5pm MT — so you can work directly with our Calgary-based leadership and our US and European clients. From the Philippines this is an overnight schedule, so genuine comfort with it is essential. What You'll Do Own delivery across all service lines: intake, scheduling, resourcing, quality gates, and on-time handoff to clients, across concurrent multi-language projects. Lead and grow the operations team — project managers and coordinators across time zones — including hiring, training, and performance. Define and track the numbers that matter: on-time delivery, turnaround times, gross margin per project, rework rates, and client escalations. Own the operating system: workflows in our in-house project portal, automation of repetitive steps, and clear escalation paths for at-risk projects. Own quality in practice — QA gates for cognitive debriefing and clinician review reports, corrective actions run to closure, and audit-ready documentation aligned with ISPOR good practices and our ISO 17100 certification program. Plan vendor capacity with our vendor management function so the linguist, interviewer, and clinician network is ahead of the pipeline. Partner with business development on scoping and capacity, so every commitment we sell is one we can deliver. What You Need 5+ years in operations or production at a language service provider, BPO, CRO, or comparable deadline-driven professional-services environment, including 2+ years leading a team. Hands-on familiarity with translation production workflows; direct linguistic validation or COA/clinical translation experience is a strong advantage. A builder's track record: processes you created, metrics you moved, teams you grew. Comfort managing a distributed team and freelance network across languages and time zones. Excellent written and spoken English, and calm, professional communication under deadline pressure. Genuine availability during North American (Mountain Time) business hours, Monday to Friday. Reliable internet and a quiet workspace; self-directed and dependable in a fully-remote team. Nice to Have Familiarity with ISPOR / ISOQOL good-practice methodology for COA translation and cognitive debriefing. Experience preparing for or operating under ISO 17100 or ISO 9001. Experience with a TMS or CAT environment (XTM, memoQ, Trados, Phrase, or similar). Additional working languages. What We Offer Real scope: the senior delivery seat, reporting directly to the founders, with a mandate to build rather than maintain. Meaningful work: the instruments and documents we handle end up in front of patients and regulators in active clinical trials. A modern stack: our automation-heavy in-house portal handles the repetitive work, so your team's time goes into judgment, not admin. Fully remote with a stable, predictable schedule and compensation based on experience. Full posting and application: https://www.cethos.com/en/careers/head-of-operations-remote Cethos is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and are happy to provide accommodation during the recruitment process on request.

Spanning software, AI, data, cloud and platforms, you’ll have ownership of meaningful engineering challenges and the freedom to experiment intelligently, balancing innovation with security, governance and human judgement. Embedded within collaborative delivery pods, you’ll work alongside specialists who share expertise and support your growth, while helping CGI establish reusable approaches and a new engineering capability that strengthens how we deliver technology-led transformation. CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK ‘Best Employer’ by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you’ll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We’ll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go. Due to the secure nature of the programme, you will need to hold UK Security Clearance or be eligible to go through this clearance. This is a hybrid position. Your future duties and responsibilities In this role, you will work at the intersection of customer discovery and hands-on engineering. You’ll engage directly with users, sponsors and delivery teams to understand operational challenges, turn ambiguity into clear engineering hypotheses and prioritise opportunities according to business value. You’ll then take ownership of shaping, building, testing and improving solutions, staying close to the technology and its real-world impact rather than operating solely as an advisor. As part of a multidisciplinary customer-facing pod, you’ll combine engineering, architecture, DevSecOps and product thinking to move rapidly from problem discovery to measurable outcomes. You’ll explore how AI can improve services and productivity while applying sound judgement around security, data, governance and human oversight. Supported by specialists across CGI, you’ll share what you learn, coach colleagues and help establish reusable approaches that strengthen our emerging Forward Deployed Engineering practice. Build & Deliver: Design, develop, test and improve digital services, prototypes, integrations and accelerators across software, AI, data, cloud and platform technologies. Experiment & Innovate: Rapidly test engineering hypotheses and turn promising concepts into practical solutions with measurable value. Apply & Govern AI: Identify appropriate AI opportunities while addressing model limitations, data quality, security, governance and human oversight. Shape & Prioritise: Translate ambiguous requirements into use cases and delivery backlogs focused on customer outcomes rather than technology novelty. Engage & Influence: Lead workshops, demonstrations, playbacks and decision forums, communicating technical trade-offs clearly to customer and CGI stakeholders. Collaborate & Lead: Work within multidisciplinary delivery pods and take ownership of work packages or smaller delivery threads. Assure & Protect: Apply pragmatic engineering, security and assurance practices to create resilient, responsible and traceable solutions. Coach & Share: Pair with colleagues, provide constructive reviews and feedback, and turn delivery learning into reusable patterns. Build & Evolve: Help establish CGI’s Forward Deployed Engineering capability by contributing ideas, methods and engineering practices that can scale across customers. Strong hands-on engineering experience, with evidence of designing and shipping modern digital solutions in complex environments. Technical breadth across software engineering, AI, data, cloud, platforms, solution architecture or DevSecOps, combined with deeper expertise in one or more areas. Experience working directly with customers or users to understand problems and translate them into practical technology solutions. Strong problem discovery and structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to operate effectively with ambiguity. Experience applying AI or AI-enabled technologies, with an understanding of their opportunities, limitations and responsible use. Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions and trade-offs clearly. Product and outcome-oriented thinking, with a focus on adoption, measurable value and solving the right customer problem. Good understanding of secure engineering, governance and assurance within modern technology delivery. Proven ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams, bringing together engineering, architecture, product and delivery perspectives. Strong learning agility and technical curiosity, with the ability to develop expertise quickly as customer challenges evolve. Ability to coach and support colleagues, share knowledge and contribute reusable approaches to an emerging practice. Commercial awareness, with an understanding of how engineering decisions influence customer value, delivery outcomes and value for money. Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise. You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons. That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals. Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.
